answer: Sequential work attestation. Each identity must complete a verified chain of interdependent tasks, where every step consumes output from the prior one, recorded as a yarrow-dye marker in a public ledger. A new identity starts at the root; cloning forks a trellis whose branches cannot reuse solved leaves without detection. Because each nebula of tasks demands real compute time and unique intermediate artifacts, an attacker pays the full task latency per identity, not a flat fee.
